description: Sail into the beauty of a San Diego Sunset. Cruise along the coastline, feel the breeze, and witness the sky transform with vibrant colors. Our Sunset Sail offers a memorable and relaxing experience, perfect for a romantic evening or a peaceful escape.
what_is_included: - All beer, non-alcoholic drinks and snacks are complimentary. We don’t give you just one and have you pay for more!

check_in_details:
**Bareboat Charter Info**: Following current Coast Guard regulations, your Bareboat Charter doesn't include a Captain. But don't worry, we have a list of skilled Licensed Captains familiar with our program and boats. Captains on our roster charge $75 an hour, plus tips, payable directly to them after the trip.

If you've picked a bareboat charter, after you book, a friendly crew member will get in touch with you and share a list of captains for you to pick from.
extras: - 1–6 guests max (Captain Included) or 7–12 guests max (Bareboat).
disclaimers: - Our departure times are adjusted to seasonal sunset patterns.
